node_definition.done_when: The a-worker-cannot-write-your-home followup f-awcwyh-grant-agrees-with-completion holds for its remaining case. tests/test_promotion_scope_counts_only_the_runs_commits.py gains a case, in a temporary repository and RECKON_HOME, that synthesises two unfenced runs sharing a directory grant (a figures directory) and leaves an uncommitted file under that directory in the first run's worktree. Completion of the second run is not refused for that file. When the case is red at the base, reckon/crew/promotion.py _repository_tree_boundary_violations attributes a dirty path to the run whose worktree holds it, not to every run whose grant covers the path. The manifest states whether the case was red at the base. A declared negative control is executed and logged under pytest: attributing the dirty path to every run whose grant covers it turns the case red. The node gate is that test file at head, ending EXIT=0. Every log sits under the run directory, headed with revision, tree and literal command, and ends EXIT=. Only tests/test_promotion_scope_counts_only_the_runs_commits.py changes, plus reckon/crew/promotion.py (the boundary-violation region) when the case was red at the base.
